C0950.title: From Entertainment to Crime: Judicial Red Lines for Gambling in Livestream Ecosystems
C0950.summary: The article reviews multiple livestream gambling convictions: Yang and others used an app's 'egg smashing' lottery to organize gambling; the 'Xingluo Yuewan' platform set up 'residue collection and cash-out' streaming rooms deemed as operating a casino; a voice platform in Duchang, Jiangxi, ran blind-box games as disguised gambling; Zheng and others used an app's blind-box draw with cash rebates;

references.title: Expert Article | From Entertainment to Crime: The Judicial Red Line for Gambling-Related Acts in the Live-Streaming Ecosystem | Accomplice_NetEase Subscription
